import json,subprocess
nodes=[]
for directory in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not directory.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  args=(directory/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
  if not any(b'MSBuild.dll' in arg for arg in args) or not any(b'nodemode' in arg.lower() for arg in args):continue
  # Only temp-directory metadata is retained; never print or record other env.
  values={part.split(b'=',1)[0].decode():part.split(b'=',1)[1].decode(errors='replace') for part in (directory/'environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in part and part.split(b'=',1)[0] in (b'TMPDIR',b'TMP',b'TEMP')}
  nodes.append({'pid':int(directory.name),'node_reuse_argument':next((arg.decode() for arg in args if b'nodereuse' in arg.lower()),None),'temp_directories_exist':{key:Path(value).is_dir() for key,value in values.items()}})
